description: Get the fee the network will charge for a particular message.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: The transaction message encoded as base64

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The configuration object with the following fields:

sub_parameters.name: commitment
sub_parameters.description: The level of commitment required for the query. The options include:

sub_parameters.name: maxSupportedTransactionVersion
sub_parameters.description: The maximum supported transaction version to return in responses. If the requested block contains a transaction with a higher version, an error will be returned. If this parameter is omitted, only legacy transactions will be returned, and a block containing any versioned transaction will prompt an error

result.description: Null if the transaction message is not found otherwise RpcResponse JSON object with the following fields:

result.context.description: The information about the current state of the program

result.context.apiVersion.description: The version of the Solana RPC API to use

result.context.slot.description: An integer representing the slot for which to retrieve the fee calculator

result.value.description: (u64 | null) The fee corresponding to the message at the specified blockhash
